subject: language
checkedBy: Opus build session, against the official PDF: The Ontario Curriculum, Kindergarten, 2026 (version issued December 2025), downloaded from the Ministry site on 2026-10-11. Every code here matches the PDF's Curriculum at a glance and Expectations by strand, and every taught-set grapheme is in the PDF's Language Foundations Continuum, Kindergarten to Grade 1.

supportingSources.title: Language Foundations Continuum for Reading and Writing, Kindergarten to Grade 4 (Ontario Ministry of Education, 2026)
supportingSources.usedFor: The kindergarten letter-sound set, the CV, VC and CVC word shapes, and the order of difficulty for blending: continuous sounds before stop sounds, and first sound before last and middle.

supportingSources.title: Kindergarten Curriculum (2026): Overall Expectations with Specific Expectations, Kawartha Pine Ridge DSB transcription, retrieved from the Ministry site 5 May 2026
supportingSources.usedFor: Overall expectation titles. Cross-check only. Where it differs from the Ministry page, the Ministry page wins.

taughtSet.orderSource: UFLI Foundations kindergarten lesson order (lessons 1 to 48 and 50), as listed in EdReports' 2025 review, filtered to the graphemes the Ministry continuum names for kindergarten. Chosen because it introduces continuous sounds early, which the continuum recommends for blending. Not confirmed as the order any Ontario board uses. A school's own order replaces it in parent settings.
taughtSet.soundTypeNote: soundType is this app's classification for ordering blending items. It is not a Ministry field.

taughtWords.source: Irregular words named in EdReports' 2025 review of UFLI Foundations kindergarten lessons, limited to the ones short sentences need. A school's own list replaces it in parent settings.
